name: Cold hauler
text: A hauler with her lights out and her holds still sealed. Whoever left her left in a hurry, and took nothing with them.

outcomes.result: The squad cracks the holds and brings back a crate of parts and some of her plating.
A hold door gives on the way out. Someone takes the weight of it, but the crate came too.

choices.label: Cut her plating
choices.result: Hull plates, cut and stacked in the hold. Slow work, and nobody gets hurt.

choices.label: Leave her
choices.result: Some ships are better left as they are.
